press_references.value: Sidra Medicine, The View Hospital partner to expand access to cord blood banking services in Qatar

partnership_announcements.description: Sidra Medicine and The View Hospital signed an agreement to make Sidra Medicine’s umbilical cord blood banking services available to eligible maternity patients at The View Hospital in Qatar.

press_references.value: Sidra Medicine and Zulal Wellness Resort by Chiva-Som Sign MoU to Elevate Wellness Programs

partnership_announcements.description: Sidra Medicine and Zulal Wellness Resort by Chiva-Som signed a Memorandum of Understanding to form a strategic partnership developing integrated wellness and preventive health programs for Sidra patients in Qatar.

press_references.value: Sidra Medicine introduces Qatar’s first advanced gene-editing therapy for sickle cell disease and thalassemia

partnership_announcements.description: Sidra Medicine and Vertex Pharmaceuticals have established a collaboration under which Sidra has been qualified as a Casgevy treatment center in Qatar, enabling delivery of the CRISPR/Cas9 gene therapy to eligible sickle cell disease and thalassemia patients.

press_references.value: Sidra Medicine signs MoU with Builders VC MENA to advance healthcare innovation

partnership_announcements.description: Sidra Medicine signed a Memorandum of Understanding with Builders VC MENA to collaborate on healthcare innovation, bringing early-stage healthtech startups into Qatar’s ecosystem and supporting commercialization of Sidra-driven innovations.

press_references.value: Sidra Medicine partners with BeginNGS to launch genome-based newborn screening research program

partnership_announcements.description: Sidra Medicine and BeginNGS have announced a new partnership to launch a genome-based newborn screening research program in Qatar, aiming to advance early detection and intervention for childhood genetic diseases.

press_references.value: Sidra Medicine joins efforts with international firm to advance AI-driven healthcare innovation

partnership_announcements.description: Sidra Medicine has signed a Memorandum of Understanding with Vitafluence.ai GmbH and EmpathicAI.Life to collaborate on AI-driven healthcare innovation. The partnership focuses on developing AI-powered healthcare delivery and digital solutions to enhance clinical decision-making and personalize patient care.

press_references.value: Qatar: Sidra Medicine inks agreement with MSH International

partnership_announcements.description: The partnership allows Sidra Medicine to provide healthcare services to a wider range of patients through MSH International's insurance network.

partnership_announcements.description: Sidra Medicine partners with the Middle East Fertility Society to host the 31st Annual Scientific Meeting in Doha, focusing on fertility care advancements.

press_references.value: Sidra Medicine expands medical education pathways through observership and future doctor programs

product_launches.description: Sidra Medicine has launched a new Medical Observership Program that provides structured, non-clinical observational learning experiences for healthcare professionals, students, and selected high school students within its tertiary academic medical center in Qatar.

product_launches.description: Sidra Medicine has introduced sacral neuromodulation as a new minimally invasive pediatric urology treatment option in Qatar, following its first successful implantation on an eight-year-old patient with spina bifida.

product_launches.description: Sidra Medicine launched Qatar’s first Autologous Serum Eye Drops, its first commercial biologic from its GMP facility, offering a prescription treatment for severe dry eye and related ocular surface conditions with local, rapid production.
